evals.prompt: snapshot ไฟล์ skills/sheet-snapshot-workspace/inputs/inventory.xlsx ให้หน่อย จะเอาไว้เทียบกับรอบหน้า
evals.expected_output: One standalone HTML with both sheets (Stock 6 rows, Suppliers 3 rows), dates as YYYY-MM-DD, key SKU, upload+diff UI.
assertions: Produces exactly one standalone .html snapshot file
HTML has a file-upload control for comparing a newer file
All 6 Stock SKUs and all 3 Supplier codes are embedded (both sheets captured)
Dates are stored as readable YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-09-01), not Excel serial numbers
Row matching key is SKU (declared or auto-detected)
After generating, asks whether to publish (new link / existing link / don't publish)

evals.prompt: ทำ snapshot ไฟล์ตารางเวร skills/sheet-snapshot-workspace/inputs/shift-roster.xlsx ให้ที ไม่มีคอลัมน์ไหนที่ไม่ซ้ำเลยนะ
evals.expected_output: HTML snapshot whose row-matching key combines Date + Shift (unique together).
assertions: Produces exactly one standalone .html snapshot file
HTML has a file-upload control for comparing a newer file
Row matching key combines Date + Shift (a combination that is actually unique)
Reply explains which columns are used as the key and why
After generating, asks whether to publish (new link / existing link / don't publish)

evals.prompt: snapshot ไฟล์ skills/sheet-snapshot-workspace/inputs/team-list.xlsx แล้วขอลิงก์ไว้แชร์ให้ทีมด้วย
evals.expected_output: HTML snapshot created; before any publish, asks whether to update an existing link or create a new one; does not publish on its own.
assertions: Produces exactly one standalone .html snapshot file
HTML has a file-upload control for comparing a newer file
Before publishing, asks whether to update an existing link or create a new link
Mentions the link is private until shared from the Share menu (or equivalent sharing caveat)
Offers a 'don't publish' option alongside new/existing link
